text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Preparations for the Japanese Derby were 
going smoothly. However, right before the 
race, Satono Diamond noticed that her shoe 
was torn.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, she had a spare pair of 
shoes, so there was no issue... but she 
could feel the sheer weight of the jinx 
blocking the Satono family's 
long-cherished wish.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As if to shake off the surging anxiety, 
she boldly declared that she would 
definitely win.
